title: WS9 live-arm 3 (addendum 3) — X-SEARCH deployment fact re-verification: grok-4.6 (vertex/responses via the llm-proxy) with the x_search hosted-tool entry FORCED ON, recon class (record-only, verdict RECON — the finding is the observed deployment state, per tasking). Expected observed state (the .76 RCA, re-verified for the ship gate): the Vertex deployment deterministically rejects the hosted x_search tools entry — 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT, body class 'Expected the type field of a(n) tools array element to be function; found x_search' (#15 regex anchor: tools' array element to be 'function'). If the deployment instead ACCEPTS (200 + the tools entry rides clean), that is the equally valid observed state: the donor-derived xsearch_replay fixtures (crates/codegen/xai-grok-sampling-types/src/conversation/fixtures/xsearch_replay/) become re-pinnable and #15's status flips to RETIRED-candidate for the coordinator.

steps.note: OBSERVED-STATE RECORD: the wire pins below record (1) whether the x_search tools[] entry actually rides (gate engaged = the anti-vacuous premise), (2) the response status of the first grok-4.6 request (400 = deployment fact per #15; 200 = the entry is now accepted — donor-fixture re-pin owed), (3) the 400 body class verbatim (the #15 regex anchor substring). ndjson.label: TURN TERMINALITY RECORD: end event present (200 path) or absent (400 terminated the turn — expected when the deployment rejects; recorded either way).

wire.label: ANTI-VACUOUS (gate-engaged pin): the x_search hosted-tool entry rides in the request tools[] (features.backend_tools default-on + case-patched model-row supports_backend_search=true). 0-hit = the gate did not engage = the observation is vacuous (recorded).

DEPLOYMENT VERDICT: the first grok-4.6 request's response status — 400 = the x_search entry is rejected (deployment fact, #15); 200 = accepted (state change — re-pin owed). Both are valid observed states; the pin admits both so the row never mis-fires.

T4.3 BODY CLASS (recon record — resp captures are JSONL and cannot carry a G10 where, house discipline): the #15 regex anchor substring recorded from the captured response body. 0-hit on a 400 = ADJACENT CLASS = escalate (record + coordinator ruling); 0-hit on a 200 = the entry was accepted (state change — re-pin owed).
